name: Cross-Weighted Modulo Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit power-of-2 condition with a cross-weighted sum divisibility rule: the sum $s_u \cdot v + s_v \cdot u$ must not be a multiple of $u+v$. Because $s_u, s_v \in \{1, 2, 3\}$ and $u \neq v$, this condition mathematically simplifies exactly to $s_u \neq s_v$. However, the explicit dependence on the node indices $u$ and $v$ masks the uniform 3-coloring constraint, forcing models to genuinely implement and evaluate the condition rather than pattern-matching to standard graph coloring.
